## 6:30 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For thus declares YHWH concerning rejected silver: "I-YHWH have-spoken; it-shall-come-to-pass." |
| LOGOS | For thus declares the LORD concerning rejected silver: "I the LORD have spoken; it shall come to pass." |
| PNEUMA | This is the LORD's declaration about rejected silver: "I, the LORD, have spoken — and it will happen." |
